speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our investigation into your acute diarrhea, please tell me how many loose stools you have passed in the last 24 hours and if you are experiencing any fever or blood in your stool.

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea, likely due to *Clostridioides difficile* infection.
